Table writes today 0 of 4 Inverter Sungrow Table layout two forced-charge windows (emulated) Slots a day up to 2, at least 30 min each Runs through midnight No Demand (MDI) limit in the inverter No Tier now Closed loop Highest the data source supports Closed loop Highest allowed Closed loop The tier is changed in Site settings by the owner, never above what the data source supports. Hold and release Overrides take effect at the next solve and the next table write. Hold Release to native Pausing and resuming control is for an administrator. Overrides in force Clear one to let the plan run as solved again. A pause and a forced charge are cleared by an administrator. No override is in force: the plan runs as solved. The table to key in Sungrow, two forced-charge windows (emulated) Copy as text Print Mon 9 Nov Tue 10 Nov Wed 11 Nov The table to key in, Mon 9 Nov Slot Start End Mode SoC % Intent 1 05:30 17:45 Charge from grid 38 Charge from the grid to 78 %; charges until 17:15 2 17:45 00:00 Discharge 20 Use the battery for the load, not below 20 % Mark as applied APPLIED LOG No table has been marked applied yet. Fallback What the inverter does on its own when no plan holds. If the plan expires, or no fresh plan arrives for 3.0 h, the inverter returns to its native settings and keeps at least 20 % state of charge. Native settings Version 1, captured 8 Nov 2026, 19:40 by demo seed (Read back) Devices and data Work mode Self use Backup state of charge 25 % Grid charging Not allowed Time slots None (one mode all day) Edge device The small computer on site that receives signed plans and reads the inverter back. No edge device: plans are delivered as daily slot tables. Without an edge device the read-back is inferred from the site's behaviour; the installer keys each day's table and marks it applied. The site's public key (Ed25519, key 071b90cd) 6YN5Umn3rV7GaD8IyejQYq3wqhAXpT0eRBO/MfYNUXo= The edge device checks every plan message against this key.
